items.name: Pettah market and Red Mosque
items.warn: Closed Sundays and full moon days
items.about: Colombo's packed old bazaar district, plus the red and white striped Jami Ul-Alfar mosque.

items.name: Galle Face Green at sunset
items.fee: free, isso wade from the stalls
items.about: Colombo's seafront promenade for sunsets, kites and street-food carts.

items.name: Ministry of Crab dinner
items.about: Crab restaurant in the old Dutch Hospital, famous for pepper and chilli crab.

items.name: Rooftop drinks or Lotus Tower
items.about: Landmark tower with a city and ocean viewing deck, or a rooftop bar instead.

items.name: Late-night kottu at Pilawoos
items.about: Late-night kottu roti from a Colombo institution open round the clock.
items.warn: Rated 3.4 on Google; it's about the 3am kottu, not the service
items.credit: Vis M, private-use only (Unsplash licence / Wikimedia Commons; licence not checked per Brittany)
items.britt: The GOAT of Sri Lankan food, on my Last Supper menu. Veggies, get the egg or cheese kottu.

items.name: Sigiriya Rock
items.about: 5th-century rock fortress with palace ruins on top and frescoes on the way up.
items.credit: Dylan Shaw, private-use only (Unsplash licence / Wikimedia Commons; licence not checked per Brittany)
items.britt: The kings used it to hide from and attack enemies. Loads of stairs, takes a couple of hours. The ponds round it used to be full of crocodiles.

items.name: Pidurangala sunrise
items.warn: Last bit is a scramble, bring a head torch
items.about: Rock next door to Sigiriya, short scramble to the best view of it.

items.name: Dambulla cave temple
items.warn: Cover shoulders and knees
items.about: UNESCO cave temples packed with painted ceilings and Buddha statues.
items.britt: Massive gold Buddha on top, and super old caves with ancient paintings. Loads of monkeys that steal food and accessories straight out of your hands, so keep an eye out.

items.name: Polonnaruwa by bike
items.about: Medieval royal capital, ruins spread out enough to do by bike.
items.credit: Secret Travel Guide, private-use only (Unsplash licence / Wikimedia Commons; licence not checked per Brittany)
items.britt: One of the oldest towns in Sri Lanka, with ruins of palaces from thousands of years ago.

items.name: Elephant safari
items.warn: December herds are at Kaudulla or Hurulu, not Minneriya; the driver picks on the day
items.about: Jeep safari to watch wild herds gather around the reservoirs.
items.britt: Go early in the morning or in the evening while they're drinking at the lakes. Not the afternoon: it's super hot, the animals sleep and you see a lot of trees.

items.name: Anuradhapura sacred city
items.warn: Full day plus 1.5 h each way from Sigiriya
items.about: The first ancient capital: giant stupas and the sacred bo tree.
items.credit: Chathura Anuradha Subasinghe, private-use only (Unsplash licence / Wikimedia Commons; licence not checked per Brittany)
items.britt: Every temple here has a story. You can walk between sites or take the cheap buses. Ruwanwelisaya is the famous ruin, and Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi has the sacred tree.

items.name: Temple of the Tooth, evening puja
items.warn: No shorts or bare shoulders
items.about: Kandy's royal temple housing the Buddha's Tooth Relic; the evening ceremony has drums.
items.britt: One of the most sacred temples. The city is nice too: touristy, with a nice walk round the temple grounds and the lake.

items.name: Knuckles day hike
items.warn: Some trails damaged by the 2025 cyclone, check which are open
items.about: Guided hike in the misty Knuckles range to the Mini World's End drop.

items.name: Kitulgala white water rafting
items.about: Grade 2-3 rapids on the Kelani river, with jungle on both banks.
items.credit: Pol van den Scheetek, private-use only (Unsplash licence / Wikimedia Commons; licence not checked per Brittany)

items.name: Nanu Oya to Ella train
items.warn: The Kandy section is shut until at least early 2027, so we drive to Nanu Oya
items.about: The best-scenery stretch of the hill country railway, tea fields all the way.
items.britt: The train through the Ella tea country is quite nice.

items.name: Horton Plains and World's End
items.warn: Mist rolls in by mid-morning, cold at dawn
items.about: Cloud-forest plateau walk to the World's End cliff edge.
items.britt: One of the coldest parts of Sri Lanka, pretty much like England: super rainy, kinda chilly.

items.name: Damro Labookellie tea estate
items.about: Hillside tea estate on the Nuwara Eliya road: walk the rows, see the factory, then tea and cake in the lounge.
items.warn: Busy with tour buses; go early
items.britt: They walk you through the whole tea process. Mine was Mackwoods, but there are loads.

items.name: Ella Rock hike
items.warn: Slippery when wet, leeches in December
items.about: Longer hike to a big valley view, partly along the railway line.

items.name: Nine Arch Bridge
items.warn: Never on the track when a train is due
items.about: Colonial stone railway viaduct in the jungle; time it for a train.
items.britt: Very famous bridge. Takes a little hike to get there but worth it, and very pretty.

items.name: Diyaluma Falls upper pools
items.warn: High December flow, slippery rock; there has been a fatal fall
items.about: Sri Lanka's second-highest waterfall, with natural pools at the top.
items.britt: Loads of waterfalls round Ella. On out-of-the-way hikes, look out for leeches in the rivers and falls!

items.name: Yala leopard safari
items.warn: Very busy with jeeps; sightings not guaranteed
items.about: Leopard and elephant safari in Sri Lanka's most famous park.
items.britt: A bit more touristy than the other safari, Minneriya. Still nice, with a beach at the end of the jungle. It was cheaper when I went, so double check.

items.name: Udawalawe elephants and Transit Home
items.about: Reliable wild elephant sightings, plus the orphan calves' feeding at the Transit Home.
items.credit: Riccardo Chiarini, private-use only (Unsplash licence / Wikimedia Commons; licence not checked per Brittany)

items.name: Weligama surf lesson
items.warn: Stay mid-bay, rips near the headlands
items.about: Gentle beginner surf bay with lots of schools.

items.name: Galle Fort and sunset
items.about: Walled colonial town with cafes, ramparts and a lighthouse.

items.name: Coconut Tree Hill
items.about: Palm-topped headland in Mirissa, a classic sunset spot.

items.name: Hiriketiya beach and surf
items.about: Horseshoe surf bay near Dickwella with beach bars.

items.name: Jungle Beach snorkel
items.about: Small cove reached by a short walk over Rumassala hill.

items.name: Proper beach day
items.about: A whole day off: beach, swim, nap, repeat.

items.name: Jaffna town: Nallur temple, fort and crab curry
items.warn: A long way north: 7.5 h from the airport. At Nallur: modest dress, men go in shirtless, shoes off. December is monsoon season up here
items.about: Tamil heart of the island: the golden Nallur Kovil, the Dutch fort, and Jaffna crab curry.

items.name: Delft Island day trip
items.fee: ferry about LKR 100 (under £1), tuk-tuk tour LKR 1,500-2,500 (~£3.50-5.50)
items.warn: December is monsoon season up here: expect rain, and boats can be cancelled. Navy ferry out about 8 to 9am, back 14:30. Don't ride the wild ponies
items.about: Ferry to a remote coral-stone island with wild ponies, a giant baobab and old Dutch ruins.

items.name: Nainativu (Nagadeepa) island temples
items.warn: December is monsoon season up here: expect rain, and boats can be cancelled. Modest dress
items.about: Short boat hop to a sacred island with a Hindu and a Buddhist temple side by side.

items.name: Aukana Buddha at dawn
items.warn: Long trousers or sarong
items.about: 12 m standing Buddha carved from one rock in the 5th century, best lit at sunrise.
items.britt: It's huge. A bit far out: tuk-tuks will take you but will try to rip you off, and it's all there is to see, so it might not be worth the hassle.

items.name: Rekawa night turtle watch
items.warn: Wild nesting turtles, so a sighting isn't guaranteed and December is the quieter season. No torches or flash. Book through the community project; the Google listing found may be a different operator
items.about: Community-run night watch where ex-poachers now guard the nests; you wait on the beach for turtles to come ashore.
items.credit: Jerzy Strzelecki, private-use only (Unsplash licence / Wikimedia Commons; licence not checked per Brittany)

items.name: Scuba diving, south coast
items.fee: Try dive about EUR 70; certified boat dives about EUR 35 each, EUR 60 for two
items.warn: Levels differ: a try dive needs no certificate (max 12 m); boat dives need one. Bring your card, and ask the centre about a refresher if you have not dived in 6 months. Do not fly for at least 18 hours after your last dive.
items.about: Pick your level: a shallow try dive with an instructor, or boat dives for certified divers. Unawatuna is the suggested base.
